judgments.reason: The phrase 'symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports bilateral jaw involvement as part of the cherubism diagnosis.

The phrase 'well-defined, multilocular radiolucent areas involving the mandibular bodies, angles, ascending rami, and the maxillary tuberosities' appears literally in the vignette and directly supports the anatomical extent of cherubism affecting both mandible and maxilla.

The phrase 'bilateral, expansile, multilocular lesions with thinning of the cortical plates of the maxilla and mandible' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports the diagnosis of cherubism involving both the mandible and maxilla.
